cell_state_mapping.input: Single-cell or single-nucleus nonnegative raw RNA counts aligned to the exact 19,264-gene order.
cell_state_mapping.output: A frozen 640-dimensional cell embedding followed by the campaign's identical common-lane head, or a separately licensed native head.
cell_state_mapping.row_universe: Use the identical eligible GSE289173 snRNA rows and frozen five-class ontology as every sealed cell-state candidate.
cell_state_mapping.split: All cells, nuclei, libraries, tissues, aliquots, timepoints, and modalities from one person remain in one donor outer fold.
cell_state_mapping.held_fit: Gene alignment is deterministic, but every learned probe, feature selection, batch correction, calibration, threshold, and native adaptation is fit inside training donors.

conditional_masld_model.reason: The license treats embeddings and gradients as outputs and restricts their use to train similar models except GenBio Materials or their downstream Derivative Works. The independent conditional MASLD model is not admitted as such a derivative.

perturbation_response.reason: Published perturbation experiments use task-specific fitting. The frozen base embedding object is not a complete perturbation predictor.

dataset_role_crosswalk.resource_atlas_current: project_exposed_training_only; fit probes and any project adaptation inside donor folds

dataset_role_crosswalk.GSE244832: project_exposed_training_or_donor-level_development; same donor is not same-cell pairing
dataset_role_crosswalk.GSE256398: external development and selection, including alcohol-associated etiology challenge; not a sealed source
dataset_role_crosswalk.GSE281367: external development and selection; not sealed
dataset_role_crosswalk.GSE289173: project-sealed final only if the checkpoint can become target-label-unexposed and all other gates pass; currently exposure unknown

input_and_missingness_firewall.raw_counts: Reject log-normalized, batch-corrected, integrated, negative, or bulk matrices in the native input lane. Reject zero-total or nonfinite rows before the official division by total count.
input_and_missingness_firewall.gene_identifiers: Freeze a one-to-one project identifier mapping into the exact gene_name axis. Duplicates, aliases, version suffixes, and ambiguous symbols are resolved without held labels.
input_and_missingness_firewall.native_zero_mask: The official helper inserts zeros for model genes absent from the assay and supplies an attention mask. Preserve the project missingness state outside the tensor so structural panel absence is not recast as a measured biological zero.
input_and_missingness_firewall.cell_zero: An assayed count of zero remains a native observed zero. Cell-specific dropout is not retrospectively relabeled from outcomes.
input_and_missingness_firewall.depth: Both depth values derive from raw total counts. Downsampled, normalized-only, or reconstructed matrices cannot silently supply fabricated raw depth.

fit_and_selection_firewall.common_lane: Freeze the exact checkpoint, source revision, gene order, raw-count preprocessing, attention mask, last layer, inclusion of depth positions, mean pooling, common head, label budget, folds, seeds, early stopping, and calibration before screening.
fit_and_selection_firewall.native_lane: No fine-tuning, LoRA, adapter, or checkpoint modification before institutional terms confirmation. Report native results separately from representation probes.
fit_and_selection_firewall.held_donors: Held and sealed donors cannot set normalization alternatives, identifier mapping choices, pooling, head architecture, calibration, exclusions, or thresholds.
fit_and_selection_firewall.labels: The sealed GSE289173 label ontology and outcomes remain evaluator-only; commit standardized predictions before joining labels.
fit_and_selection_firewall.replication: Donors are inferential units. Cells, nuclei, genes, batches, seeds, and model layers are not independent donors.

rules.all_unknown_fail_closed: Every target source remains unknown until the exact 50-million-cell checkpoint corpus is resolved to accession, release alias, donor, retained-cell, label-use, and training-cutoff records.
rules.chronology: A public date after an original weight upload or before a later safetensors conversion does not prove private-data exclusion. A conversion commit is not evidence of retraining.
rules.exposure_vs_terms: Even a future clean or target-label-unexposed classification would not override the noncommercial, revocable, output-training, or redistribution restrictions.
rules.source_owned_results: The paper's zero-shot, annotation, and perturbation results are prior work, not discoveries or external validation of this benchmark.

claim_boundary.current: No MASLD cell-state champion, no sealed external claim, and no conditional-model contribution.
claim_boundary.future_comparator: If institutional terms, exact corpus, runtime, input, and capability gates pass, GB.Cell may be reported as a restricted frozen comparator with donor-level metrics.
claim_boundary.clinical: No diagnostic, prognostic, treatment-response, or deployment claim.

interpretation: GB.Cell is technically relevant to cell-state mapping because it consumes transcriptome-scale single-cell counts and exposes a deterministic pooled embedding recipe. It is not admitted now. The 50-million-cell corpus lacks a checkpoint-bound source inventory, all Atlas overlaps remain unknown, the runtime is not locked, and the license restricts noncommercial use, distribution, and training similar models from embeddings or other outputs.
